title: Antique Brass Multi Hook, 6 Position Wall-Mounted Rack, 15.5-Inch Solid Brass, Mercury Collection, Allied Brass
description:
Clear up bathroom clutter with a wall-mounted multi hook that keeps towels and robes organized and easy to grab in Antique Brass, which features a softened, aged golden patina that brings vintage charm and character to traditional spaces. This 6 position wall hook rack (also used as a towel hook and robe hook) brings coordinated style to transitional bathroom hardware in the Mercury Collection.

Highlights:
- Antique Brass brings warm, timeless elegance
- Choose from 25 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Add reliable strength with solid brass and brass construction
- Choose a look that coordinates with matching Mercury pieces and grooved bath accessories
- Designed for bathroom / bath use with a corrosion-free, rust-free designer finish

Specs & Installation:
- Product type: Multi hook / wall hook rack / robe hook strip
- Collection: Mercury Collection
- Material: Brass (solid brass construction)
- Mounting type: Wall mount, wall-mounted, wall hanging (concealed screw mount)
- Dimensions (L x H x W): 15.5 x 3.2 x 4 inches
- Weight capacity: 2 lb
- Included items: Multi hook and all installation hardware
- Assembly required: No
- Screw size: #8 x 1 1/4 in
- Warranty: Limited lifetime warranty
